Still have questions?

What does Wilson Concierge actually do?
Wilson sends updates, handles questions, and keeps everyone — internal teams and external partners — in the loop.
Who receives updates from Wilson?
Both your team and your customers. You decide who gets notified and when.
Can updates match our brand?
Yes. Wilson sends fully branded emails and tracking pages with your logo, colors, and voice.
Does Wilson replace my customer service team?
No. Wilson handles routine communication so your team can focus on the situations that need a human touch.
What kind of messages does Wilson send?
Pickup confirmations, delays, ETA changes, delivery notices — all automated, all clear.
Can I control how often Wilson sends messages?
Yes. You set the rules — which events trigger alerts, how often, and who’s copied.
Does Wilson notify when something goes wrong?
Absolutely. Wilson flags exceptions early and alerts both your team and ours if escalation is needed.
Is there a live tracking link for customers?
Yes. Every shipment includes a branded, real-time map and status page your customer can check any time.
